rows.name: Anaphylactic Shock
rows.functional_text_plain: Each opposing hero and ally that has dealt damage to you this turn loses 1{h}.

rows.name: Pitfall Trap
rows.functional_text_plain:
This can only be played from arsenal.
When this defends, deal 2 damage to the attacking hero unless they pay {r}.

rows.name: Tripwire Trap
rows.functional_text_plain:
This can only be played from arsenal.
When this defends, hit effects don't trigger this chain link unless the attacking hero pays {r}.

rows.name: Rockslide Trap
rows.functional_text_plain:
This can only be played from arsenal.
When this defends, target attack gets -2{p} unless the attacking hero pays {r}.

rows.name: Boulder Trap
rows.functional_text_plain: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment the attacking hero controls.

boundary_scope: Only selected newShock, three explicit CRUlegacy restrictions and one unrestricted OUTTrap. Not a catalog-wide migration/completeness claim.
